info.title: ReWortha API
info.description: Repair or Replace Decision Support API. Integer IDR, deterministic rational comparison, immutable snapshots. Relative difference = absolute monthly difference / higher exact monthly cost; <= configured threshold means CLOSE_CALL. Monthly normalization is not a total-spending forecast.
